expected.exit_basis: contract-declared placeholder corroborated by the reference child process exit; the product runner ABI is UNBOUND
expected.exit_semantics: A positive case succeeds only if the case child process exits 0 AND the typed token is emitted AND every predicate holds. The engine wrapper exit is not case evidence; exit 0 alone is NOT a product PASS. The product runner ABI is UNBOUND in this set.

predicates.assertion: The POS child process exits 0 and the wrapper exits 0.
The NEG child is a separate process that exits 2 with a typed refusal token.
POS and NEG each have their own cwd, stdout and stderr, and both are marked independent_raw true.
predicates.verify: len({r.cwd for r in records}) == 2 and all(r.independent_raw for r in records)

predicates.assertion: Case PASS, operation established and refusal established are recorded as separate booleans, all true.
predicates.verify: case_pass and operation_established and refusal_established are all True

predicates.assertion: The pack tree digest is unchanged across the POS/NEG run.

predicate_contract: Each predicate is independently checkable from the produced case record or from the real filesystem. A token match alone never satisfies the oracle; all predicates must hold.
not_covered: The original product runner/oracle/fixture remain UNBOUND; exit 0 alone is not PASS. The POS/NEG child used in the reference run is an evidence-root helper, not a product runner.
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; this oracle was frozen before the product run; an oracle change requires a CR and a new case revision; an old FAIL is preserved
